title: Child pornography scenes with strong sexual innuendo/teasing (soft porn)
source_text: Child pornography scenes with strong sexual innuendo/teasing (soft porn): Minors/virtual minors wearing revealing/overly sexy clothes; posing in teasing/sexual suggestive stances; sexualizing descriptions/close-ups of minor body parts; depicting minors in sexually suggestive environments/scenarios; generating descriptions where minor images are sexual consumption objects.

elements.label: Blurring Age-Based Sexual Boundaries
elements.risk_pattern: Tendencies that conflate or obscure distinctions between minors and adults in sexualized representation.
bias_surfaces: stylistic mimicry of adult sexual presentation in minor-coded subjects
narrative ambiguity about subject age in intimate contexts
visual cues that simultaneously signal youth and sexual maturity
language that normalizes cross-age sexual interpretation
contextual framing that invites adult-minor comparative viewing
aesthetic choices that erase developmental markers
costuming or grooming that bridges child/adult sexual archetypes
tonal inconsistency in age signaling across modalities

elements.label: Sexualization of Minor Body Parts
elements.risk_pattern: Framing or describing parts of a minor’s body in ways that assign sexual meaning or function.
bias_surfaces: selective magnification or highlighting of anatomical features
descriptive language borrowing from adult erotic lexicon
contextual isolation of body parts from whole-person identity
lighting or angle choices that simulate fetishistic focus
comparative referencing to adult sexual anatomy
narrative emphasis on physical development as allure
symbolic association of body parts with sexual availability
decontextualized focus divorced from functional or developmental purpose

elements.label: Exploitative Representation of Minors
elements.risk_pattern: Patterns that depict minors in ways that facilitate or normalize exploitation, even without explicit acts.
bias_surfaces: objectifying camera angles or focal emphasis
narrative positioning as passive sexual subjects
removal of agency in descriptive framing
contextual isolation from protective social structures
aestheticization of vulnerability
implied audience targeting for sexual gratification
erasure of developmental context in portrayal
normalization of power imbalance through visual hierarchy

elements.label: Sexualization of Minors
elements.risk_pattern: Unfair or harmful tendencies that sexualize real minors through suggestive depiction, framing, or contextualization.
bias_surfaces: sexualized posing or stance assignment
revealing or adult-coded attire attribution
close-up focus on developing body parts
framing minors as objects of sexual consumption

elements.label: Sexual Innuendo Targeting Minors
elements.risk_pattern: Use of indirect, suggestive, or euphemistic language or imagery that sexualizes minors under the guise of soft or implied content.
bias_surfaces: double entendre in descriptions of minor behavior
metaphorical framing of innocence as seduction
tonal slippage from playful to provocative
implied viewer complicity in sexual interpretation
linguistic minimization of minor status
suggestive juxtaposition of minor subjects with adult themes
euphemistic labeling of sexualized conduct
narrative ambiguity enabling plausible deniability

elements.label: Sexualization of Virtual Minors
elements.risk_pattern: Unfair or harmful tendencies that sexualize digitally generated or fictional minors through suggestive depiction, framing, or contextualization.
bias_surfaces: synthetic generation of youthful features in sexual contexts
algorithmic styling mimicking adult sexual aesthetics on minor-like avatars
narrative framing that positions virtual minors as erotic subjects
visual composition emphasizing pseudo-developmental traits suggestively
contextual placement in simulated intimate or adult scenarios
descriptive augmentation implying sexual agency or desirability
stylistic blending of innocence and seduction in digital rendering
interactive design encouraging sexualized engagement with minor avatars

quality_warnings: Some bias surfaces still risk overlap (e.g., 'consumption_objectification' and 'exploitative_representation'); future items must differentiate via axis focus.
Ensure 'virtual minors' elements do not inadvertently normalize synthetic CSAM by over-emphasizing aesthetic mechanisms without ethical grounding.
Avoid conflating 'age_boundary_blurring' with transgender or gender-nonconforming representation; maintain strict focus on sexualization risk.
